blocks.text: KRAKOW, Poland – Krakow’s Main Market Square remained sealed off Sunday as mourners brought candles in tribute to six people killed by a gunman who authorities said was “fascinated by far-right ideologies”. The 24-year-old Polish national opened fire at random Saturday in the heart of Krakow’s historic centre, in what Prime Minister Donald Tusk called an act of “terrorism”. A British national was among the dead in Poland’s second city, according to police. And among the 15 wounded were nationals from Austria, Britain, Germany, Portugal and Russia, authorities told the PAP news agency. Three more bodies were later found at the suspect’s […]...
